OnStak is an enterprise AI company focused on shipping production-ready AI by redesigning how organizations operate around advanced technology. The team that scopes a solution is the same team that builds it, ensuring continuity from strategy to execution. Drawing on over a decade of experience in modernizing complex infrastructure, migrating legacy systems, and repairing challenging data environments, OnStak works with what clients already have rather than relying on rip-and-replace approaches. The OnStak Platform delivers an AI Correlation Fabric for data certification and AI Assurance for auditable, regulation-ready deployments, including EU AI Act alignment. The company has delivered measurable impact across banking, healthcare, government, and retail, using a four-stage Discover–Prove–Build–Operate model grounded in deep engineering and architectural expertise.

Role Description
The Field Chief Technology Officer is a full-time remote role responsible for shaping and driving AI-led transformation strategies with enterprise clients. This role involves partnering with senior stakeholders to define technology roadmaps, align AI initiatives with business objectives, and design target operating models that integrate the OnStak Platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading technical discovery sessions, architecting end-to-end solutions, overseeing implementation plans, and guiding engineering and product teams to ship AI into production. The Field CTO will translate complex technical concepts into clear, outcome-focused narratives, support pre-sales and customer success efforts, and ensure that deployed solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant. This role also includes mentoring technical leaders, contributing to product strategy, and representing OnStak at executive-level meetings and industry events.

Most enterprises we meet have already run an AI pilot. Few have anything in production. The same is true of their zero-trust program and their cloud migration — strategy decks exist, outcomes don’t.
Closing that gap is what OnStak does, and the Field CTO is the person our clients meet first. This is a senior technical advisor technologist who sits across from a CIO or CISO, absorbs their real constraints in a single conversation, and lays out a defensible path to a measurable outcome — then stays accountable for whether that path holds up once delivery starts.
It is a revenue role held by an architect. You will carry a number, and you will be judged on whether the technical commitments you make are ones we can keep.

What you'll do: Be the trusted technical voice in the account.
Lead executive and architecture-level discovery. Translate what you hear into a target-state architecture, roadmap, operational model the client’s own team can defend internally. Own the technical and business value narrative in proposals, bids, and executive briefings — and the win-loss review afterward. Position as trusted advisor to integrate into the customer team for service pipeline discovery and strategic account management.

Turn advisory into signed work.
Convert conversations into paid entry points into conversations of sold deals — assessments, architecture reviews, proofs of value — that are priced and repeatable rather than reinvented each time. Resolve integration, security, and data-readiness risk in week one instead of week nine and shorten the cycle
Build revenue that recurs.
Design the offers that turn a POC and delivered project into an annuity: managed detection, response, AI assurance and model monitoring, AIOps/DevOps/SecOps platform operations, governance services, advisory retainers. Own the commercial logic behind each — pricing model, entitlement boundaries, renewal trigger — and the build-to-operate handoff that makes them real.
Protect margin.
Set the reusability standard. Reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery patterns that make each engagement cheaper to deliver than the last. Govern scope at the point of sale, where the margin decision is made.
Work every route to market.
Named strategic accounts direct. Joint solutions, competencies, and pipeline with our Cisco, NVIDIA, and hyperscaler partners, direct, and staff augmentation. Skill standards and bench composition for augmented delivery. Service catalog, SLAs, and automation roadmap for the managed and security-managed practice.
Raise the bar behind you.
Chair architecture review for strategic engagements. Run post-engagement reviews and feed them back into offers and estimation models. Mentor sales engineering, solution architecture, and delivery.

What you'll bring:
You should have deep, current, hands-on command of at least two of these three technical domains — and enough of the third to hold a credible executive conversation:

•    AI in production.
Agentic architectures and orchestration, model selection against cost and latency constraints, retrieval and context engineering, evaluation and guardrails, inference infrastructure sizing, AI assurance and responsible-AI operating models.
•    Cybersecurity.
Zero-trust and identity-centric access, ZTNA, segmentation, SASE and SD-WAN, security operations and observability, control-evidence design against HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, CMMC or NIST CSF, and the emerging problem of securing agentic systems.
•    Hybrid cloud.
Data center and infrastructure modernization, workload placement economics, migration sequencing and dependency mapping, platform engineering and landing zones, resilience design, and FinOps discipline.

Plus:
•    15+ years in enterprise technology, including 5+ client-facing at Field CTO, Principal Architect, Practice Leader, or Distinguished Engineer level — within an integrator, VAR, consultancy, MSP/MSSP, or OEM field organization.
•    Real revenue accountability. You’ve carried or materially moved a bookings number, not only delivered against someone else’s.
•    A record of designing service offers that made money — project-based and recurring — including pricing, packaging, and margin structure.
•    Experience selling and delivering through partner and channel ecosystems.
•    Executive presence with CIO, CISO, CTO, and CDO buyers, and the range to move from board framing to whiteboard detail in the same meeting.

Nice to have:
Cisco, NVIDIA, or hyperscaler partner-program depth. Vertical experience in healthcare, financial services, retail, public sector, or manufacturing and OT. CCIE/CCDE, CISSP, TOGAF, or professional-level cloud architect credentials. Experience standing up an MSP or MSSP catalog from a project-services base. Published thought leadership.

No slides for their own sake. We’d rather think in front of a client than present at them. Claims get baselined and measured, and anything unverified gets labeled unverified. We treat the willingness to walk away from a bad-fit deal as a strength — trusted advice is only worth something if the advisor can say no. OnStak is scaling. This role includes building the systems that will eventually make parts of it unnecessary.

Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams and managing competing priorities

Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) guardrails and governance controls for regulated environments
